source.title: Data on anatomy, movement, and foraging behaviour of three cattle breeds of different productivity
source.licenseCaveat: Zenodo API metadata declares CC BY 4.0 at metadata.license.id; the rendered record page has an empty license field; no independent legal review.
source.attribution: Pauler, C. M. et al. (2020). Data on anatomy, movement, and foraging behaviour of three cattle breeds of different productivity. Frontiers in Veterinary Science. https://doi.org/10.3389/fvets.2020.00494. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3707638.

evaluation.horizonBasis: Article describes a 10-week grazing experiment; exact individual weighing dates are absent from the deposited file.
evaluation.observedAdgFormula: (Weight_2 - Weight_1) / 70; both endpoints are recorded in kg.
evaluation.engineInputs: Observed initial weight only; 1 simulated animal; default initial pasture ledger and default pasture/diet/normal-weather/no-supplement configuration. No cow-specific forage, intake, supplementation, weather, or measured pasture state is supplied.
evaluation.engineParameterFitting: none; engine.js is unchanged by this diagnostic.
evaluation.interpretation: This compares one frozen engine component with derived endpoint ADG in a small, separate mature-cow grazing cohort. It has no animal identifiers or exact interval dates and does not align management/forage inputs. It is not an independent full-engine validation, calibration, prediction-interval assessment, causal estimate, or evidence to mix into the approved USDA/CPER yearling-steer case.

limits: Twenty-seven cows at one Swiss alpine research setting, nine per breed, are not representative of Brazilian farms or the USDA/CPER yearling-steer cohort.
The 70-day horizon is inferred from the article; exact per-cow weighing dates are not deposited.
The input file lacks a stable individual identifier, so metrics are descriptive and no animal-cluster bootstrap is claimed.
The engine scenario uses default pasture state and does not receive measured forage quality, pasture mass, weather, DMI, or cow management inputs.
The result measures only ADG component discrepancy; it cannot validate weight trajectories, DMI, cost, forage inventory, treatment effects, or uncertainty coverage.
